subject: On-prem pilot: scheduling and compliance evidence for Mediq
messages:
From: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@mediq.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-20T20:15:00Z
Subject: Request: on-prem demo for Mediq pilot (SOC2 evidence needed)

Hi Naomi,

We completed the self-serve sign-up and outlined a pilot for a private/on-prem deployment. Our compliance team is asking for an on-prem demo focused on tenant isolation, network requirements, and SOC2 evidence before we move to procurement. Can you run a short technical demo (30–45 min) next week that includes:
- A walkthrough of the private deployment architecture (VPC/on-prem options)
- KV cache/data isolation and audit log demo
- A quick SOC2 evidence summary (controls mapped to data-handling)

Attendees: me and our security lead (will confirm). Procurement will likely join later, but for scheduling please leave a few slots that work for your SE. We are US-east (ET) heavy.

Thanks — Emily
Dr. Emily Chen
Head of Clinical AI, Mediq Health
emily.chen@mediq.com
(415) 555-0194
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@mediq.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-21T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: on-prem demo for Mediq pilot (SOC2 evidence needed)

Hi Emily — great to hear from you and glad the self-serve flow got you started.

We can absolutely run a tight technical demo and include a short SOC2 summary. Proposed 30–45m windows (all ET):
- Tue 2027-09-21 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2027-09-21 15:00–15:45
- Wed 2027-09-22 11:00–11:45

Olga (our SE) will lead the architecture and live walkthrough; I’ll cover compliance + audit logs. Vivek (cc’d) will coordinate the calendar.

Attached: SOC2_summary.pdf (one-pager mapping of controls we typically surface). Can you confirm:
1) Final attendee list (security + procurement contact)?
2) Any strict firewall/egress constraints we should know up front?

If none of those windows work, Vivek will send a short poll / Calendly.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@mediq.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-21T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: on-prem demo for Mediq pilot (SOC2 evidence needed)

Hi Emily — quick intro, I’m Vivek on the SDR/ops side. Thanks for the details.

Here’s a short scheduling link if any of Naomi’s proposed windows don’t fit: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-se-onprem-demo

Olga will join to run the technical portions. Marcus (cc) is our infra lead in case we need to pre-share network templates.

Question for you: do you prefer a virtual demo with a side-by-side network diagram, or a short walkthrough that we record and share for your procurement team? Also, if procurement needs specific evidence (e.g., encryption in transit details, HSM/KMS usage), let us know and we’ll surface it.

Thanks — I’ll hold Tue 15:00 ET tentatively until I hear back.
– Vivek
From: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@mediq.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mediq.com
Date: 2027-09-21T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: on-prem demo for Mediq pilot (SOC2 evidence needed)

Thanks Naomi / Vivek — appreciate the quick reply.

Procurement is looped in (procurement@mediq.com) and would like to attend the session that discusses network/ops. Our compliance reviewer prefers Tue morning ET when possible — that would make Tue 10:00 ET the best option. If Tue 10:00 is still open, can we lock that?

Also, could you send the network checklist your team uses (IP ranges, ports, outbound endpoints) so our ops team can pre-clear it with the firewall team? If you can attach a spreadsheet, that’d be ideal.

We can also accept a short recording if scheduling conflicts arise, but prefer a live session.

Emily
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Dr. Emily Chen <emily.chen@mediq.com>, procurement@mediq.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-22T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: on-prem demo for Mediq pilot (SOC2 evidence needed)

Emily / procurement team — locking Tue 2027-09-21 10:00–10:45 ET for the live demo (calendar invite to follow).

Attached is our standard network_requirements.xlsx (IP ranges, ports, hosts to whitelist, and recommended egress controls). I’ve also re-attached SOC2_summary.pdf for your compliance reviewer.

Agenda (30–40m):
- 10:00–10:05 — quick intros and scope (Naomi)
- 10:05–10:25 — on-prem/VPC architecture + tenant isolation demo (Olga)
- 10:25–10:35 — audit logs, data residency, and SOC2 highlights (Naomi)
- 10:35–10:45 — Q&A and next steps (procurement/ops)

Next steps we’ll complete after the call: share detailed deployment checklist, links to the private deployment repo, and a draft MSA if procurement requests. For tracking, I referenced HS-45321 in our CRM.

If anyone needs a different timezone or cannot make Tue 10:00 ET, tell Vivek and he’ll circulate the poll.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Naomi
